analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of ona.com/docs covered 584 pages (100% crawl coverage of 601 in-scope pages). Site contains 10 confirmed broken internal documentation links and 18 unverified links blocked by authentication or rate limits. API reference coverage stands at 59.96% across 96 detected API pages. Only 22.77% of pages display last-updated metadata, severely limiting freshness transparency. Overall audit confidence is 65.79%, with links confidence notably low at 30.71%.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved (100% of 601 in-scope pages)
No repository navigation broken links detected (repo_broken_links_count: 0)
API page detection successful with 96 pages identified across the site
Trap URL detection prevented crawl pollution (12 trap URLs skipped)
High crawl confidence at 95.0% ensures topology accuracy
risks: 10 confirmed broken internal documentation links degrade user navigation and trust
18 unverified links create uncertainty; may hide additional broken links behind authentication
API reference coverage at 59.96% leaves 40% of API surface undocumented or poorly linked
SEO/GEO issue rate of 13.61% impacts discoverability and search ranking
Freshness metadata visible on only 22.77% of pages obscures content currency for users
Links confidence at 30.71% indicates significant verification gaps
Example code reliability estimated at only 75.0%, risking developer onboarding friction

prioritized_actions.action: Fix all 10 confirmed broken internal documentation links immediately
Investigate and resolve 18 unverified links (authentication/rate-limit issues)
Increase API reference coverage from 59.96% to minimum 85% by documenting missing endpoints
Implement last-updated timestamps on all pages (currently 22.77% coverage)
Remediate SEO/GEO issues affecting 13.61% of pages (meta descriptions, titles, structure)

limitations: External audit cannot verify links behind authentication walls or rate limits (18 URLs unverified)
Example code reliability at 75.0% is an estimate; actual runtime validation requires environment access
API coverage detection depends on pattern recognition; undocumented or non-standard API pages may be missed
Audit cannot assess content accuracy, technical correctness, or alignment with actual product behavior
Freshness analysis limited to visible metadata; actual content update dates may differ from displayed timestamps
